title: What We Have Left
description: Jonas, Liora, and Tomas are all here — in the same room, at the same time. Every choice you have made as a mother and a wife has been leading to this conversation.

title: Budget Allocation — Post-Crisis Stabilization
description: The coup attempt — whether it succeeded or failed — has economic consequences. Capital is frozen, markets are watching, and the IMA is asking pointed questions. Stabilize the fiscal picture while you still can.

title: Government Formation — Coalition Building
description: The political landscape has shifted. Allies have become liabilities. Opponents have become potential partners. The math of survival requires a new equation.

title: International Forum — Emergency Session
description: The Forum has convened an emergency session on the Veltrian crisis. Every ambassador will speak. Every power will position. You need to be heard before the narrative is written without you.

title: Liora — After Everything
description: Liora came home after the coup attempt. She didn't say anything about the protest, the arrest, the photograph. She just sat at the kitchen table and waited for you to notice she was there.
